name: Manipur
tagline: The Land of Jewels and Lakes

topAttractions.name: Loktak Lake
topAttractions.description: The largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, known for its floating islands and diverse wildlife.

topAttractions.name: Kangla Fort
topAttractions.description: A 14th-century fort complex that served as the capital of the Manipuri kingdom and is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

topAttractions.name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
topAttractions.description: A protected area and home to the endangered Manipuri brow-antlered deer, also known as the Sangai.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Manipur is from October to May, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Manipur is home to the ancient Meitei script, a unique writing system that dates back to the 11th century and is still used by the Meitei people today.

hiddenGem.name: Moirang Keithel
hiddenGem.description: A 200-year-old marketplace in Moirang that is a hub for local handicrafts and traditional Manipuri clothing.

relatedFestival: The Manipur Sangai Festival, a celebration of the state's rich cultural heritage and natural beauty.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Loktak Lake or the Kangla Fort, you might be interested in visiting the nearby Keibul Lamjao National Park to spot the elusive Manipuri brow-antlered deer!
